name: Negative flow positive price divergence
hypothesis: Buy only after sustained negative net flow fails to produce lower executable prices and a range high breaks.
spec: Setup: Stable price despite sales can indicate demand that absorbs supply. Entry: Buy only after sustained negative net flow fails to produce lower executable prices and a range high breaks. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on renewed lower prices or divergent data-quality alarms. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs swap-level flow and trade-size cohorts over time (not connected)
